title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Issues Concerning the Launch of a Special Campaign to Intensively Crack Down on Illegal and Criminal Gambling Activities
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Conducting a Special Campaign to Concentrate on Cracking Down on Illegal and Criminal Gambling Activities

Gongtongzi [2005] No. 2

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the People's Procuratorate and Public Security Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In recent years, various types of illegal and criminal gambling activities have become increasingly rampant. In particular, the penetration of overseas gambling industries has intensified, online gambling has spread rapidly, and "Mark Six" and private lottery gambling activities have become rampant in some areas. The number of people going abroad to gamble or participating in online gambling is growing daily. The number of party and government leading cadres, civil servants, and heads of enterprises and institutions participating in gambling is on the rise, resulting in substantial losses of state funds and triggering numerous social problems, drawing strong reactions from the masses and all sectors of society. In order to crack down on illegal and criminal gambling activities, maintain social security and stability, and uphold social management order, it has been decided to launch a nationwide special campaign to concentrate on cracking down on illegal and criminal gambling activities from January to May 2005. The relevant requirements are hereby notified as follows:

1. Raise Ideological Awareness and Effectively Enhance the Sense of Political Responsibility and Urgency in Conducting the Concentrated Crackdown on Illegal and Criminal Gambling Activities

The spread of gambling has multiple and long-term harmful effects. Conducting a special campaign to concentrate on cracking down on illegal and criminal gambling activities is an inevitable requirement for practicing the important thought of "Three Represents" and strengthening the construction of three civilizations. It is an important measure for building a harmonious socialist society and consolidating the Party's governing foundation. Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels must deeply understand the serious harm of illegal and criminal gambling activities and the importance and urgency of cracking down on them. From the strategic height of thoroughly implementing the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Party and the Fourth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth Central Committee, diligently practicing the important thought of "Three Represents," and improving the Party's governing ability, they should, with a high sense of responsibility toward the Party and the people, fully exercise their functions, carefully plan, coordinate operations, resolutely crack down on the social vice of gambling, effectively deter crime, purify the social environment, and maintain social harmony and stability.

2. Highlight the Key Targets of the Crackdown and Strictly Crack Down on Illegal and Criminal Gambling Activities in Accordance with the Law

Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels must fully understand the characteristics of such illegal and criminal activities, fully exercise their functions, and lawfully crack down on lawbreakers engaged in illegal and criminal gambling activities. Through the special campaign, a number of gambling gangs and dens shall be destroyed, a number of gambling websites shall be eliminated and blocked, a number of major and important gambling cases shall be investigated and solved, and a number of gambling criminals shall be severely punished. Among them, the key targets for punishment are organizers of gambling criminal groups and online gambling, organizers of "Mark Six," football betting, horse racing betting, and other gambling activities, as well as party and government leading cadres, civil servants, and heads of enterprises and institutions who participate in gambling criminal activities.

In the special campaign, cases shall be handled strictly in accordance with the Criminal Law and relevant judicial interpretations, the criminal gambling acts shall be accurately identified, and the quality of case handling shall be guaranteed. For those who gather people for gambling or establish a gambling house for the purpose of profit, regardless of whether they themselves participate in gambling, criminal liability for the crime of gambling shall be pursued. For those who make gambling their profession for the purpose of profit, regardless of whether they actually make a profit, criminal liability for the crime of gambling shall also be pursued. For those who, by establishing offices or representative offices within the territory of China or distributing advertisements, solicit or organize Chinese citizens to gamble abroad, and if this constitutes a crime, they shall be convicted and punished for the crime of gambling. Circumstances such as instigating others to gamble, organizing minors to gather for gambling, or establishing gambling houses to attract minors to participate in gambling, as well as state functionaries committing the crime of gambling, shall be dealt with strictly according to law. For those who commit crimes such as embezzlement, misappropriation of public funds,职务侵占 (occupational embezzlement), misappropriation of unit funds, misappropriation of specific funds or materials, or bribery, and use the proceeds from the crimes for gambling, they shall be punished more severely in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law. If the acts also constitute the crime of gambling, concurrent punishment for multiple crimes shall be imposed in accordance with the Criminal Law. Property penalties such as confiscation of property and fines, as well as measures such as recovering illegal gains and confiscating personal property and criminal tools used for gambling, shall be fully utilized to economically sanction criminals and eliminate the economic foundation of gambling crimes. The criminal policy of combining punishment with leniency shall be adhered to, treating cases differently with leniency and severity to the greatest extent possible to disintegrate the criminals. Those who voluntarily surrender or perform meritorious acts such as reporting or exposing illegal and criminal gambling activities may be dealt with leniently according to law.

A strict distinction shall be made between illegal and criminal gambling activities and normal recreational activities of the masses. Recreational activities involving small amounts of money as winnings or losses conducted without the purpose of profit, as well as business operations such as providing chess and card rooms or other entertainment venues and only charging fixed venue and service fees, shall not be treated as gambling. For those who participate in gambling with relatively large sums of stakes, public security organs may impose public security penalties according to law. Those who meet the conditions for reeducation through labor shall be subjected to reeducation through labor according to law. Those who violate Party discipline or government disciplinary rules shall be subject to disciplinary sanctions by the competent authorities. Cases shall be handled strictly according to law. For those who constitute crimes, there shall be no leniency or tolerance, and it is strictly prohibited to substitute fines for criminal punishment or downgrade the handling. For those who do not constitute a crime or should not be subject to administrative sanctions, they shall not be attacked or dealt with, and normal recreational activities of the masses shall not be interfered with under the pretext of prohibiting gambling.

3. Strengthen Coordination and Cooperation to Form a Joint Force for Crackdown

Currently, gambling criminal activities are not only numerous in quantity but also highly organized, involve a wide range of participants, employ covert methods, and have strong capabilities for evading crackdown. In handling cases, public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels shall adhere to seeking truth from facts, scientifically and correctly understand the particularities of such criminal activities, follow the principle of "basic facts clear and basic evidence conclusive," avoid dwelling on trivial details, closely cooperate, and crack down on gambling criminal activities with severity and speed according to law. Public security organs shall organize specialized forces to conduct thorough investigations. When a public security organ in the place where a gambling criminal act occurs discovers the criminal act, it shall immediately file a case for investigation according to law, make every effort to clarify the criminal facts, and arrest the criminal suspects. Efforts shall be made to collect, fix, and preserve evidence, laying a solid foundation for prosecution and trial. People's procuratorates shall promptly review and approve arrests and review for prosecution in accordance with the law for criminal suspects for whom the public security organs request approval of arrest or transfer for review and prosecution. People's courts shall promptly try cases in accordance with the law when people's procuratorates initiate public prosecutions. Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels shall strengthen cooperation and mutual checks, strictly handle cases according to law, and ensure case quality.

4. Conduct Extensive Publicity and Mobilization to Promote the In-Depth Development of the Special Campaign

During the special campaign, public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels shall make full use of various news media to vigorously publicize relevant laws and policies, demonstrating to the masses the determination and confidence of the Party, the government, and political and legal organs in cracking down on illegal and criminal gambling activities. Typical cases shall be selected for public exposure to deter crime and educate the masses, enabling the broad masses to establish a sense of law-abidingness, voluntarily stay away from, and resolutely resist gambling activities. A reward system for reporting shall be established, with reporting hotlines, mailboxes, and websites set up. Rewards shall be given to members of the public who actively provide leads and help solve major gambling cases, mobilizing the masses to report and expose crimes, thereby creating a favorable atmosphere for cracking down on illegal and criminal gambling activities.

Upon receipt of this notice, all localities shall promptly deploy its implementation. Any issues encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security respectively.

January 10, 2005
